environment: Local Go API through same-origin Vite proxy, PostgreSQL 16.14 isolated qa05_browser schema, three synthetic sessions

checks.name: history
checks.detail: Both DM participants received HTTP 200 and the same three-message history; a nonparticipant received HTTP 404.

checks.name: navigation_and_search
checks.detail: The nonparticipant navigation contained zero DMs and its scoped DM search returned HTTP 404; participant scoped search returned HTTP 200.

checks.name: session_boundary
checks.detail: Each request used a separate login-issued session cookie. The local HTTP client supplied its secure cookie in the Cookie header; the browser smoke separately confirmed session cookies across reload and logout.

limitations: Only synthetic non-production data was queried; this does not establish deployment ACL or browser notification delivery.
The third account was a member. A nonparticipant administrator was covered by PostgreSQL integration tests, not this HTTP smoke.
